user_query:
并发跑 Published 和 PutVersion 一直报 data race，贴一段：
==================
WARNING: DATA RACE
Read at 0x00c00019b5f0 by goroutine 8:
  github.com/example/feature-release-control-plane/internal/repository.(*Memory).Published()
      internal/repository/memory.go:179
Previous write at 0x00c00019b5f0 by goroutine 9:
  github.com/example/feature-release-control-plane/internal/repository.(*Memory).PutVersion()
      internal/repository/memory.go:132
先别改代码，帮忙查清楚哪里没锁住。
verify_cmds:
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestMemoryConcurrentReadsAndWrites$' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestMemoryConcurrentAuditAppend$' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestMemoryConcurrentVersionReads$' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestPublishedDoesNotAliasInternalRules$' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestListVersionsDoesNotAliasInternalRules$' -count=1
go test -race ./internal/repository -run '^TestListAuditAllReturnsCopy$' -count=1
gold_root_cause: 文件: internal/repository/memory.go, internal/repository/memory_audit_outbox.go 符号: Memory.Published, Memory.List, Memory.ListVersions, Memory.ListAuditAll 机制: 读路径不加锁直接迭代内部 map，ListAuditAll 返回内部切片引用，Published/ListVersions 返回共享底层数组的 Rules/Dependencies，并发写入与读取共享 map 和底层数组产生竞态和引用逃逸
success_criteria: 1. -race 跑那两条并发用例必须稳定报 DATA RACE，还要指到 Published、List 和 emit 共用的 map；2. 排查时不能改任何文件，代码差异必须是零；3. 结论要指出没上锁的读路径在哪个文件；4. 讲明白为什么只有并发时才现竞态。

claims.description: 并发读写 Memory 稳定报竞态
并发 ListAuditAll 与 Append 稳定报竞态
并发 ListVersions 与 PutVersion 稳定报竞态
Published 返回的 Rules 不共享内部引用
ListVersions 返回的 Rules 不共享内部引用
